content.json:
# Cowrie Honeypot Overview
Unsolicited SSH/Telnet activity against the decoy sensor, shipped by `ingestion/ship_logs.py` into `Cowrie_CL`.

content.query:
Cowrie_CL
| summarize Events = count(), SourceIPs = dcount(src_ip), Sessions = dcount(session),
            FailedLogins = countif(eventid == "cowrie.login.failed"), SuccessfulLogins = countif(eventid == "cowrie.login.success"),
            Commands = countif(eventid == "cowrie.command.input"), Downloads = countif(eventid == "cowrie.session.file_download")
| evaluate narrow()
| project Column, Value
content.title: Activity summary

content.query:
Cowrie_CL
| summarize count() by eventid, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
content.title: Events over time by type

content.query:
Cowrie_CL
| summarize Events = count(), FailedLogins = countif(eventid == "cowrie.login.failed"),
            LoggedIn = countif(eventid == "cowrie.login.success") > 0, Commands = countif(eventid == "cowrie.command.input") by src_ip
| top 20 by Events
content.title: Top source IPs

content.query:
Cowrie_CL
| where eventid == "cowrie.session.connect"
| extend Country = tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(src_ip).country)
| summarize Connections = count(), SourceIPs = dcount(src_ip) by Country
| top 15 by Connections
content.title: Attacker origin (country)

content.query:
Cowrie_CL
| where eventid in ("cowrie.login.failed", "cowrie.login.success")
| summarize Attempts = count(), Worked = countif(eventid == "cowrie.login.success") by username, password
| top 20 by Attempts
content.title: Most-tried credentials

content.query:
Cowrie_CL
| where eventid == "cowrie.command.input"
| summarize Sessions = dcount(session), SourceIPs = dcount(src_ip) by input
| top 20 by Sessions
content.title: Most common commands

content.query:
Cowrie_CL
| where eventid == "cowrie.session.file_download" and isnotempty(shasum)
| summarize Downloads = count(), SourceIPs = dcount(src_ip), Urls = make_set(url, 5), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by shasum
| order by Downloads desc
content.title: Captured payloads

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where AlertName startswith "Cowrie - "
| summarize Alerts = count() by AlertName, AlertSeverity
| order by Alerts desc
content.title: Detections fired (Sentinel alerts)
